text: Chanhu Jo Daro Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Chanhu Jo Daro Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Sindh District: Shaheed Benazirabad Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: This archaeological mound is located in Jamal Kirio village, Nawab Shah. It consists of four small and one large mound. It measures 290x210x7m. The site was initially excavated by E.J.H. Mackay in 1935-36 and has found burnt brick houses and drainage system. Other antiquities include potshards, chert blades, t/c bangles, chisels, beads, etc. Latitude: 26.170833333 Longitude: 68.330555556 Ownership: Private Legal Status: Not Protected Title of Publication: Nawab Shah: The Lost Glory Published In: Indus Publications, Karachi Year of Publication: 2002 Bibliography/Reference: Shah, S.
